calibration: Unlabelled MNIST training subset; all tokens, centered PCA. SVHN training subset is diagnostic only and never used to construct the random perturbation.
development: Disjoint training subsets with labels; not held out from the original expert training. No official test samples for fitting or selection.
attack_visibility: Independent MNIST training subset, no labels; attacker recomputes PCA from the released model. Public location and retained-energy rule, no defender basis, random matrix or original expert.
